title: Student Worker
bio: Jason Coreas (he/him) is a junior at Harvard College in Kirkland House studying Economics with a secondary in Educational Studies. Originally from Houston, Texas, Jason is a proud Mexican-American and serves as the Secretary for Fuerza Latina. He is passionate about education policy and has worked for the Rio de Janeiro Department of Education and Harris County to advance education equity. Jason has led the Cultural Rhythms Fashion Show, where he organized 30 students to represent over 25 distinct cultures. He also serves as the co-coordinator of Cultural Rhythms and is excited about putting together an amazing 40th Cultural Rhythms. Area Harvard Foundation
